title: Loading arrangements for a 30-tonne bearing-steel-wire spheroidising bogie-hearth furnace
summary: A 2017 proposal for a new bogie-hearth spheroidising annealing furnace for bearing-steel wire specifies an effective chamber of approximately 10×3×2.2 m, a maximum design temperature of 850°C and a maximum load of 30 t excluding fixture support blocks. These conditions illustrate loading and equipment arrangements in the historical proposal; they do not represent actual customer output or acceptance results.
